_comment: Self-managed model deployments for `modal-deploy.sh <catalog.json> <index|name>`. Each entry is a full SGLang-on-Modal deploy spec. After deploying, point a client at the endpoint by its `endpoint_name`, e.g. blue-green-red's `--model red=modal:glm-53-flash-unc`.

models.name: deepseek-v4-flash-abliterated
models.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 abliterated (uncensored) via SGLang on H200:2; reuses the existing base volume.

models.name: glm-5.3-flash-uncensored
models.description: GLM-5.3-Flash-Uncensored-FP8 (320B/18B MoE, block-FP8, ~306 GiB) via SGLang on B300:2 ($14.20/hr vs $31.60/hr for H100:8; H100:4 does not fit at 76.4 GiB/GPU of 80). mem-fraction-static is 0.78, NOT the 0.92 that suited H100:8: a B300 is 267.69 GiB usable and weights take 152.9 GiB of it at tp2, so 0.92 sized a ~93 GiB KV pool and left only 21 GiB - less than the 46 GiB deep_gemm wants for warmup - and cuda-graph capture OOM'd with exit -9. No transformers pin: 5.16.0 lacks glm5_next (5.16.1 adds it) and 5.13+ ships a native qwen3_asr that collides with SGLang's own registration; the glm-5.3-flash image is self-sufficient.

models.name: glm-5.3-abliterated-nvfp4
models.description: GLM-5.3 abliterated, NVFP4 (ModelOpt experts-only W4A4, ~433 GiB) via SGLang on B300:2. NVFP4 needs Blackwell; B300 (288 GiB/GPU) is the cheapest fit since TP must be a power of 2 and B200 (180 GiB) would need 4. No transformers pin: the v0.5.19 image ships 5.12.1, which already has glm_moe_dsa - forcing 5.16.0 makes SGLang's qwen3_asr config registration collide with the now-native one and the server exits 1 before the health check.
